These settings replace yours in Corbanu Terminal sessions and their child agents:
"now" shows this session; web search, environment, shell and roles are as loaded at launch.
• Sandbox now: profile corbanu-aggressive: commands can write to the current folder; permission-request tools are off
  Aggressive: write only in the current folder (where the Corbanu home and the nested-launch registry stay read-only): no extra writable folders, no /
    tmp or $TMPDIR; approved commands stay inside it too; escalation and permission-request tools are off; the project's .codex and .agents stay read-
    only, even with Grant once; reading credential files (.env, .env.* and .envrc files, also ones created later, on Windows from the next command on;
    SSH, cloud and CLI tokens) or Corbanu's sign-in, vault, config and history is denied to agent commands and is never granted, not even once (switch
    to Permissive in /security to allow it)
• Approvals now: untrusted (reviewer: you)
  Aggressive: untrusted: you approve every command that is not known read-only (reviewer: you, never auto-review)
• Network now: off for agent commands; web search disabled
  Aggressive: off for agent commands; web search off
• Vault now: the vault store and sign-in file are unreadable to agent commands; only allowlisted environment variables reach agent commands (for
    example PATH, HOME, locale, terminal, proxy and tool locations; secretless_agent_launch); set others explicitly in shell_environment_policy.set;
    login profiles and shell snapshots are not used
  Aggressive: the vault store and sign-in file are unreadable to agent commands, and direct `corbanu vault …` commands are refused; secret-like
    environment variables (KEY, SECRET, TOKEN, VAULT, PASSWORD, PASSPHRASE, CREDENTIAL) are removed, and with secretless_agent_launch on so is every
    other variable outside an allowlist (for example PATH, HOME, locale, terminal, proxy and tool locations; set others explicitly in
    shell_environment_policy.set); login profiles and shell snapshots are not used
• Model keys now: held by the isolated credential broker (broker_model_auth on)
  Aggressive: provider API keys from the environment or the vault are held by the isolated credential broker, which sends model requests for Corbanu
    (sign-in tokens are passed to it; command, AWS and header sign-ins are not brokered; realtime and websockets are off); if it cannot start, model
    requests are refused, never sent directly (broker_model_auth; `broker_model_auth = false` in your own config keeps it off)
• Child agents now: spawned agents get this session's values
  Aggressive: spawned agents get the same values; custom roles that would change them are refused at start; Claude panes are refused because Claude
    Code runs outside the sandbox, unless contained_external_agents and secretless_agent_launch run them in it, asking you before every command, file
    edit and web request (reading files stays automatic) (Claude Code sign-in still runs)
• Nested agents: refuse. An agent command that starts another agent (`corbanu exec`, `review`, `resume`, `fork`, a new session, `app-server` or `mcp-
    server`) is refused.
